required.description: Whether writes must contain this field.

MeterTotal.description:
One bounded billable total DTO. Integer values stay strings to avoid JSON
number precision loss in JavaScript clients.

MigrationStatus.description:
Resumable migration state.  The worker that processes documents reports
progress through [`SchemaService::record_backfill_progress`].

completed.description: Number of documents durably acknowledged by the worker.

message.description: Actionable status text for dashboard/CLI consumers.

next_cursor.description: Opaque resume cursor.  It is never interpreted as SQL.

total.description: Number of documents known to the worker at operation creation.

from.description: Source field for a rename, when applicable.

index.description: Index name for an index backfill, when applicable.

to.description: Destination field for a rename, when applicable.

covered_kinds.description: Journal kinds currently covered by this endpoint; additional owners remain explicit.

created_at.description: Optional because some owner journals do not persist a creation time.

revision.description:
Durable journal revision; viewing does not advance it.
Optional because member-local journals may not expose a revision.

state.description: Queued, running, or succeeded, derived only from committed owner state.

joins.description: At most eight explicit relations, read from the same authority snapshot.

select.description: Return these base fields after sorting; absent selects the full record.

oneOf.description: Deterministic scalar order with ascending ID ties.

All AND terms must match, plus at least one OR term when present,
independent of request order (Better Auth 1.7.2 Kysely/Drizzle grouping).
Insensitive membership folds strings only for homogeneous string lists.

value.description:
Missing fields are null. Eq/ne against null are null checks; ne against
a non-null value excludes null records. Empty `in`/`not_in` match none/all.
Nonempty `not_in` excludes null records and matches nothing with a null list member.

database_id.description: Canonical database ULID allocated durably by the authority.

operation_id.description: Stable operation identifier supplied by the caller.

parent_database_id.description: Parent identity of a provisioned branch.

state.description: Authority progress; create never implies serving readiness.

ReactiveEnvelope.description: One indexed sync-v1 MessagePack envelope: [major, minor, features, tag, correlation, causation, body].

ReadAttribution.description: Read counters are attribution-only and never appear as billable meters.

total_reads.description: Aggregate reads observed since this Engine opened; reads are never billed.

generation.description: Current lifecycle generation. Pass this to [`ApplyRequest`].

truncated.description: Whether more recommendations exist beyond this bounded response.

resume_cursor.description: Latest opaque cursor returned by export status.

RotateWebhookSecret.description: A bounded window for receiver migration to a new signing secret.

overlap_seconds.description: Seconds to include the previous signature, from zero to 3600 (default 300).

SchemaDocument.description: The durable response to an apply operation.

identity.description: Immutable database identity observed when this record was created.

SchemaIndexDescriptor.description: An ordinary or FTS index descriptor.

fields.description: Ordered extracted fields in the index key.

oneOf.description: Index implementation kind; omitted means the canonical B-tree kind.

unique.description: Whether duplicate values are refused within a region.

SchemaTarget.description:
A durable target.  `branch` is part of the identity, not a mutable field
in a schema record, so a schema can never accidentally cross a branch.

branch.description: The immutable branch pin (`main`, or a cloud development branch).

collection.description: The collection whose schema is managed.

transactionId.description:
Begin accepts a label of at most 100 UTF-8 bytes. Commit and rollback
require the returned canonical identity, which is at most 128 bytes.

field.description: Timestamp field used as the expiry deadline.

UsageSummary.description:
Authoritative database totals at one immutable usage ledger high-water.
Amounts remain decimal strings to preserve integer precision for clients.

meters.description: The only two billable meters. Storage includes only finalized intervals.

reads.description: Live read attribution since this Engine opened, outside the billable snapshot.

snapshot_sequence.description: Durable ledger high-water shared by all totals.

storage_complete_through_millis.description: Storage totals include finalized intervals only; null means no interval is finalized.

WebhookEndpoint.description:
A webhook endpoint as stored durably.  Secrets are never part of this
value, serialized responses, delivery logs, or error messages.

deleted.description: Whether new deliveries are disabled by deletion.

secret.description: Base64url-encoded, unpadded signing key. Decode before MAC verification.

WebhookSecretResponse.description: One-time signing material returned only by creation and rotation.

Soft-deletes one database: restorable for seven days. The backup
stream stops with it; retention owns the artifacts (S-06).

Returns one database's record with the routing headers; a database this
member's region does not host answers the 421 contract (D-58).

Backups ride Litestream per file (S-06): readiness is an artifact
fact, never "the child process is alive".

`POST /databases/{name}/backups/restore` — restores to a NEW database
(D-29: a restore never lands on the live file), optionally at a point
in time (`"at"`: unix milliseconds).

`POST /databases/{name}/branches` — restore plus register with parent
metadata (D-38/D-39).

get.summary: Lists the distinct collections a database's documents occupy.

Lists one collection's documents in canonical key order, with bounded
paging (`?limit=`, `?after=` by identifier).

post.summary:
One atomic batch of document mutations (create/replace, merge patch,
delete) in a single engine transaction: every op commits together or
the typed refusal names the offending op and nothing lands.

delete.summary: Deletes one document (tombstone; the history route can explain it).

get.summary:
Returns one document with its `ETag`; `If-None-Match` is answered from
the revision column alone — the body blob is never decoded on a 304.
`?at=<unix-millis>` reads the document as of that moment from a
throwaway point-in-time restore (S-06 time-travel, cached per
(database, second) with a bounded budget).

patch.summary:
RFC 7386 merge patch over one document: objects merge per field,
`null` deletes a field, anything else replaces the whole value. The
read-modify-write is one engine transaction against the snapshot.

put.summary:
Creates or replaces one document; the `ETag` of the result names the new
revision.

get.summary:
One document's retained revision history, newest first (D-42: history
is journal retention). Conflict explanations — "why this version won" —
ride the S-05 replication lane; a single-region document has no
conflicts to explain yet.

Lists one collection's index descriptors: field, state, and the rows
the governed backfill still owes (D-31/D-42).

post.summary:
Registers one extracted index column on a collection (D-31): the field
gains stored columns written by the Rust write path, existing rows are
backfilled inline inside the cost cap, and ordinary indexes cover the
columns. Idempotent for an identical descriptor.
